localChanges: The Civilopedia's Wonder pages now say what each Wonder does and where, such as the Pyramids letting you change government without Anarchy, or J.S. Bach's calming 2 citizens in your cities on its continent (#1196).

log: With its rule set on, this rule takes the place of civ1-wonder's United Nations rule, so it carries the same description. Requires core-rule 0.1.11.

Each Wonder's rules describe what they do with core-rule's Description, from the same constants the rules use, saying where each acts (its city, all its owner's cities, or its owner's cities on its continent). Requires core-rule 0.1.11.
